location.description: Physical location of the server (shown in directory listings).

admin.description: Contact email for the server administrator.

hostname.description: Public hostname clients use to connect to this server.

bind_address.description: IP address the main HTTP(S) listener binds to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 or 0.0.0.0).

ssl_certificate.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format, cert+chain).

ssl_private_key.description: Optional separate private key path (if not embedded in certificate file).

webroot.description: Directory containing web interface files (e.g., status.xsl).

admin_username.description: Username for Icecast admin web interface and admin API.

admin_password.description: Password for admin user — change in production!

source_password.description: Password encoders (e.g., OBS, liquidsoap) use to stream to /source mountpoints.

relay_password.description: Password for relaying (pull/push) to/from other Icecast servers.

relays.description: Static relay configurations (pull/push relays to other Icecast servers).

local_mount.description: Local mountpoint name (where it appears to clients).

relay_shoutcast_metadata.description: Pass Shoutcast metadata through to listeners.

basedir.description: Base directory for runtime files (used with chroot).

logdir.description: Directory where log files are written.

pidfile.description: Optional path to PID file (empty string disables).

alias.description: Default fallback alias for root path (e.g., '/').

accessformat.description: Access log format string (strftime + Icecast tokens).

logsize.description: Max log file size (KB) before rotation.

chroot.description: Whether to run Icecast in a chroot jail (recommended for security).

changeowner_user.description: User to drop privileges to after startup.

changeowner_group.description: Group to drop privileges to after startup.

maxclients.description: Maximum total clients (listeners + sources + admins) allowed.

maxclientpulls.description: Maximum number of pull relays per mount.

maxqueueSize.description: Max bytes queued per mount for slow clients (0 = unlimited).

queueoutgoing.description: Queue size (bytes) for outgoing stream buffer.

fallback_mount.description: Fallback mountpoint to redirect to when source is unavailable.

fallback_override.description: Whether to allow listeners to override the fallback by specifying ?mount=...

fallback_when_full.description: Whether fallback triggers when queue is full (even if source is present).

mount_public.description: Default value for <public> in mountpoints (whether listed in directory).

mount_stream_name.description: Default stream name for new mounts.

mount_stream_url.description: Default URL linking to the station’s website.

mount_hidden.description: Default value for <hidden> (hidden mounts not listed publicly).

mount_burst_size.description: Number of bytes to burst to new listeners (to fill buffer quickly).

mount_mp3_meta_interval.description: Interval (bytes) between metadata updates for MP3 streams.

mount_audio_info.description: Key/value metadata injected into audio headers (e.g., {'samplerate': '44100', 'channels': '2'}).

items.description: Audio info key-value pairs (e.g., samplerate=44100, channels=2).
